programme.title: 走吧！旅行中 Eddie Walker
programme.desc: 台灣首創旅遊實境秀，由旅遊達人Eddie王啟村以旅拍方式全程記錄，自然捕捉旅遊中最美好的瞬間，帶著觀眾透過鏡頭一起環遊世界！

programme.title: 陝辣香辣
programme.desc: 以陝西特色辣味美食為線索，透過城市鄉野街道等場景，結合麻辣豬肝碗托禮泉烙麵小炒泡饃等代表性菜餚，展現三秦大地的飲食文化與煙火氣息

programme.title: 野火烤不盡
programme.desc: 從繁華的都市到寧靜的鄉野，圍繞烹飪方式燒和烤，拜訪各地的燒烤掌門人，看他們如何玩火，將普通食材變成垂涎美味，深入感受煙火升騰的燒烤文化和熱情洋溢的多彩生活

programme.title: 火辣辣
programme.desc: 火辣辣是由多位人氣男星（家發方偉傑包勳平Teddy）聯手主持的無厘頭高能量美食外景節目主持群將化身尋辣特派員，跨越 8 個國家與地區，深入當地的菜市場節慶與傳統廚房從挑戰世界第一辣的卡羅萊納死神椒，到品嚐將辣椒融入甜點的奇特飲食文化，他們不僅要探尋辣椒背後的種植與製作祕密，更要親自參與各地的吃辣大賽，挑戰人體味覺的極限！究竟他們能順利問鼎辣椒王的寶座，還是會被辣到俯首稱臣？

programme.title: 奇食記
programme.desc: 人類的文明史，在本質上就是一部食物的進化史在漫長的歲月中，人們過去賴以生存的食物，逐漸蛻變成了精緻的美食，各式各樣的烹飪手法也賦予了食材更加豐富多層次的美味

programme.title: 第一餐第1季
programme.desc: 該片深入街頭巷尾，探尋近30個城市的傳奇早餐店，以溫暖詼諧的風格呈現豐富的早餐美食與人間煙火...

programme.title: 人生一串第1季
programme.desc: 少了點煙火氣，人生就像是一場孤獨的旅程從雲南昭通一口一串的牛肉小串塔克拉瑪干沙漠裡用紅柳枝串起的霸氣烤羊肉，再到廣西百色讓人既害怕又想試的炭烤豬眼睛夜市與街角邊的燒烤攤遍佈各地，每一攤都有自己獨門的在地風味節目用鏡頭穿梭在街頭巷尾，記錄下最平民的在地美食與夜市傳奇，以最貼近生活的視角，真實呈現那一串串燒烤背後的人情味與故事在享受每一串燒烤帶來的極致美味時，也帶大家一起品味最真實最接地氣的人生滋味

programme.title: 夜市王1
programme.desc: 節目透過ETtoday的民調，挑選出台灣每個縣市中最讚的夜市，再依據台灣各縣市人口比例，安排出賽的名額，最後通過喜愛程度進行邀請每一集開始將決定出賽順序，並嚴格控管出菜時間，全程不停機錄影，每次上菜間隔3分鐘並經由評審試吃，來決定當集最好吃的店家排名各評審排序後將平均計算得出綜合排名，並依照F1積分制分別給出分數每3集將淘汰部分夜市，並在最終拿到冠軍封號與100萬元獎金

programme.title: 貞觀之治

programme.title: 知味新疆
programme.desc: 該片深入食材原生地，講述新疆人與美食的故事，展現當地多元的民族文化勞作智慧與匠心精神，並借助空拍水下縮時等鏡頭語言呈現視覺藝術張力紀錄片包含自然孕育甜蜜記憶等分集主題，既聚焦特色風味，也傳遞了民族共同體意識與人文煙火氣息

programme.title: 和田食光
programme.desc: 和田，地處天山之南，位於巍峨的昆侖山與廣袤的塔克拉瑪干沙漠之間，扼守古絲綢之路要衝中華文明源頭的昆侖文化傳承古今的玉石文化與貫穿東西的絲路文化在這裡綿延千年，孕育出深厚悠久的人文歷史與多姿多彩的民族文化，也催生出內涵豐富多元融匯獨具特色的和田美食

programme.title: 開夜車
programme.desc: 無論是騎兩輪的自行車，開四輪的轎車還是乘坐六輪的公共巴士，是否都劫數難逃？ 網紅小奈為了沖點擊率，說服了姐妹們在鬼月一同探索傳說中鬧鬼的路段及附近公園裡的自行車道，拍成視頻為了能夠拍到靈異物體，小奈甚至故意觸犯禁忌，結果真的招惹了好兄弟她的下場會如何？

programme.title: 霍元甲之精武天下
programme.desc: 清朝末年，八國聯軍入侵後，日軍趁機進駐天津開設武館，展開征服中國的第一步此舉激發了天津習武之人的愛國意識，一代宗師霍元甲將代表天津的武者們，接受日本武術的挑戰，守護鄉里眾人的尊嚴

programme.title: 雲南蟲谷
programme.desc: 胡八一等人由於之前探險而身上出現會帶來詛咒的印記，據說放在古滇國獻王陵墓中的?塵珠能解開詛咒，胡八一等人只好深入瘴癘之地眾人穿過古滇國秘密地下水道，不料遭遇千年痋術機關，成千上萬個痋俑倒懸在洞頂；深入叢林，更是不斷遭遇重重考驗終於，歷經兇險來到獻王墓入口，然而更大的挑戰也接踵而至

programme.title: 劇場版派遣女醫 X Final
programme.desc: 當今的日本，白色巨塔已然崩壞，本該是拯救生命的醫療體制，也被迫迎來弱肉強食的時代在陷入危機的日本醫療現場，一群獨來獨往的自由醫生出現了，他們就像獨行俠般，不受體制牽絆，一如這位美麗性感的天才外科醫生大門未知子（米倉涼子飾演），她討厭成群結黨討厭權威討厭束縛，專業醫師執照與扎實養成的醫術，是她的唯一武器 這回，大門為了拯救某國總統的生命而離開日本...

programme.title: 大釣哥
programme.desc: 大釣哥的兒子不叫小釣哥，叫藍小龍藍正龍 飾手腳敏捷攀岩走壁，跟著老爸專偷扒手偷來的竊物救濟貧戶，希望引出老爸的世敵黑熊吳朋奉 飾演 不料，為了幫助法律系畢業的心儀對象黃心怡謝沛恩 飾赴美深造，小龍竟向黑熊借了兩百萬！在某次火拼時，為黑熊頂罪，以現行犯被收押大釣哥為了幫兒子洗清罪嫌，請求舊識同時是檢察官吳克群 飾的母親白秀娟楊貴媚 飾聯手追查真相時，扯出案外案，逆轉全局戲碼，即將爆笑爆淚登場

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅一夜變調，現今的他窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助多年未見的女兒小寶和她的律師男友乃華與此同時，老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片在網路瘋傳，讓他獲得了拍電影的機會

programme.title: 天降神機
programme.desc: 黃星徹，18歲，幼時跟隨祖父母住在沿海一帶，直到國中才搬回與父母同住，期待著一個陌生又溫馨的家庭關係，然而好景不常，家中因父親賭債開始四處躲藏，母親也在償還債務後毅然決然離去，阿徹看在眼裡對母親沒有怨恨反倒徒留不捨，然而對以酒洗面的父親極度埋怨，兩人相處充滿在仇恨與怨懟之中，因父親在工地打臨時工與警察二叔的投靠，阿徹也在不停轉換學校與環境的過程，養成自力更生的能力，但一切轉換的不適與父親的關係等無處發洩，藉由打架與不良學生的標籤得以找到暫時的存在感

programme.title: 新龍門客棧之英雄覺醒
programme.desc: 東海將領周淮安護孤女曲靈來到龍門島上的龍門客棧，客棧中暗流湧動，東西兩廠輪番上陣，掌櫃金鑲玉百般試探，周淮安深感此行目的愈發撲朔迷離，龍門島世代血咒驚現仙藥之迷，東廠馮督主為謀得仙藥殺害曲靈，周淮安會為家族榮耀順從馮督主還是秉持內心正義奮起反抗？一場正義與邪惡的生死較量就此展開

programme.title: 周處除三害
programme.desc: 劇情描述通緝犯陳桂林（阮經天 飾）在角頭大哥告別式上囂張尋仇，卻發現自己竟然只是排名第三的通緝犯，於是他查出前兩名通緝犯的下落，要將他們一一除掉

programme.title: 唐人街探案3
programme.desc: 繼曼谷紐約之後，東京再出大案唐人街神探唐仁（王寶強 飾）秦風（劉昊然 飾）受偵探野田昊（妻夫木聰 飾）邀請前往破案CRIMASTER世界偵探排行榜中的偵探們聞訊也前往東京，加入挑戰，而排名第一Q的現身，讓這個大案更加撲朔迷離，一場亞洲最強神探之間的較量即將爆笑展開

programme.title: 夜生活女王霞姐傳奇
programme.desc: 從中國移居香港的王霞葉子楣飾在茶樓賣點心，後遇人不淑被騙成為性工作者但王霞憑著對歡場生意的觸覺，及抓緊機會依附各種勢力人士，一步一步從舞廳媽媽生晉身至娛樂場所夜總會老闆，見証色情行業的轉變

programme.title: 宮:14
programme.desc: 講述了身為古董店繼承人的女主人公誤入時空隧道，穿越至清朝康熙年間，在入宮成為一名宮女之後，陷入了康熙朝九子奪嫡的明爭暗鬥和諸阿哥們的情感糾葛之中，最終雖明知前途兇險，仍與心上人相守不離不棄的故事

programme.title: 吉林的月光
programme.desc: 來自吉林的巍巍為了母親龐大的醫藥費，放下長春中醫學院的學業遠嫁台灣，承諾家鄉親友會過得幸福，卻莫名變成大哥的女人在大哥跑路後，生活無以為繼的巍巍，憑藉一身推拿功夫在按摩店裡工作維生，卻不時要面對顧客要求提供特別服務以及警察的臨檢 某次烏龍的抓姦行動之後，小警員家豪對巍巍一見鍾情巍巍對親友虛構的美好生活，在童年好友的突然訪台下就要被揭穿，尋求家豪假扮老公的巍巍，眼看一場鬧劇即將上演卻無法收手，究竟等著巍巍的是殘酷的真相還是渺茫的幸福？

programme.title: 超級學校霸王
programme.desc: 劇情描述西元2043年，超級犯罪家將軍被捕，由於未來員警戒守森嚴，其手下於是穿越時光隧道來到50年前的香港，意欲改變歷史香港政府見事態嚴重，急派飛龍特警（劉德華等人）回到1993年的香港，保護50年前余鐵雄法官

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 某日紀曉嵐在赤膊編修四庫全書時，乾隆突然駕臨，來不及穿衣的紀只好躲到桌子下面，被乾隆叫出後靠機智才避免欺君之罪乾隆微服私訪，顯露出一般平民的喜怒及愛打抱不平的愛心，與草民周日清結下友誼，並在周的幫助下，查出和教訓了一批貪官污吏

programme.title: 麻雀王
programme.desc: 20多年前，阿發（杜汶澤 飾） 和阿順（李國煌 飾） 都是麻將天尊儒五常（曾志偉 飾）的徒弟但如今阿發在怡保老街角落一間殘舊咖啡店賣釀豆腐，這間小店生意不算很好，但也過得去，最主要是這裡有一 群幾十年的老顧客，因此生意無憂阿發的妻子雷夢娜（葉璇 飾） 多年前已經出走，丟下他獨自撫養女兒四喜，如今四喜已是個花樣年華的少女

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 九品後補知縣包龍星辦案能力不足，深受百姓唾棄此時戚家發生滅門慘案，倖存的戚秦氏指認常威為兇手，但常威之父水師提督常昆運用權勢誣陷戚秦氏為犯人，而星亦被調離此案當夜星與其侄有為回凶案現場找證據翻案，反而被打入大牢星逃獄後決心替戚秦氏洗刷冤屈，隨一雜技團上京告御狀

programme.title: 排球少年!!-日語:19
programme.desc: 自從在電視上看了一場排球總決賽後，國中生日向便深受啟發，儘管身高不如人，仍然參加排球社，開始受訓

programme.title: 鹿鼎記:27
programme.desc: 鹿鼎記是金庸的封刀之作，也是金庸篇幅最長，風格最為獨特的作品，它是一鄰悲劇性的英雄史詩，是金庸為其昔日筆下創造出的無數江湖英雄唱出的一曲無盡輓歌，小說以清代康熙年間的社會歷史為背景，描寫了一個出身於社會最底層的少年韋小寶的傳奇經歷

programme.title: 笑傲江湖:7
programme.desc: 笑傲江湖，其背景是明朝萬曆年間，東西廠橫行互鬥的年代禁宮武功秘笈葵花寶典被盜，東廠公疑為林震南所為，暗派錦衣衛奪回寶典 林震南向華山掌門岳不群求救，岳派出大弟子令狐沖（許冠傑飾）和女兒岳靈珊（葉童飾）赴援此時，東廠公派人隨五嶽盟主左冷禪（劉兆銘飾）對付林震南各路人馬各懷心事，聚集於染布房左冷禪以夫人與兒子威脅林震南交出葵花寶典，林見情勢不利，將秘笈藏匿之處（在水車下）告訴令狐沖，叮嚀他務必將此告訴兒子林平之東廠滅絕林家三口，並嫁禍於苗族的日月神教...

programme.title: 青春還鄉2025地方創生微電影:7
programme.desc: 近年，有愈來愈多的年輕人用地方創生的方式回到家鄉創業，運用原本所學的專長，改善既有生產模式，以品牌行銷模式，推動在地經濟，創造地區共好也有原非當地居民因為熱愛土地，移居偏鄉，靠著熱忱與信念，努力推廣在地文化與產業，讓文化能夠繼續傳承，環境也能永續發展

programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

她她她的少女時代:15
programme.desc: 人到中年，營役半生，方迎風的人生卻迎來遽變！失婚失業，女兒離巢，她迷失她頑抗，卻體力衰退與社會脫節身為別人的女兒老婆老媽，她卻忘了少女時代，也曾是個熱血勇悍瘋狂追星的搖滾樂迷！二十年前的輕狂歲月，二十年後的柴米油鹽，面目全非的她，竟重遇當年迷戀的偶像！偶像潦倒不堪，丈夫欲斷難斷，種種挫折與衝擊，迫使她直面過去的失敗，重新振作，激勵自己與身邊人唱著一首首動人歌曲，一群失意的中年男女，再次出發，為了自己，再活一次！

programme.title: 大醬園:13
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山與夫人席德容堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿及葉細么兩女加入，與其子萬卓楓成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石啟川及啟江醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 女士的品格
programme.desc: 講述了工作狂姚薇身為公司商務部女總管，在事業蒸蒸日上的上升期意外發現自己懷孕，因而掀起一連串職場與家庭的挑戰

programme.title: 以美之名
programme.desc: 透過各類求美者的真實故事，直擊現代社會的容貌焦慮醫美產業亂象以及背後的心理創傷與自我重生劇中兩位女主角在公立與私立體制專業堅持與商業營運的碰撞中，攜手破除整形偏見，探討美的真正意義

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa

programme.title: Pendosa Ingin Ke Syurga
programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn Abdullah menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

programme.title: Geng Daddy Daddy
programme.desc: Hafiz dan isterinya Melissa apabila ibu bapa Melissa secara mengejut datang ke rumah dan tinggal bersama-sama untuk beberapa hari. Pelbagai perkara lucu berlaku dan cuba di atasi oleh Hafiz yang selama ini mengharapkan isterinya melakukannya saperti memasak, menyembelih ayam dan membasuh baju.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Taufik cuba merebut perhatian Ana dari Johan tanpa menyedari yang Edora dan Johan sedang memerhatikan mereka. Mereka berasa cemburu kerana dapat melihat ada sesuatu di antara Taufik dan Ana dari cara mereka berbual dan memandang satu sama lain. Edora tertolak Taufik hingga kakinya terseliuh.

programme.desc: Marlia marah kerana Hans membuatkan Ira jatuh. Sikap Ira yang tetap kasar dan kurang sopan terhadap Hans membuatkan Rashid marah. Rashid menasihati Hans supaya mendidik Ira menjadi isteri yang baik. Rashid mahu Hans mula bekerja di syarikatnya kerana Ira sudah semakin pulih. Marlia tidak setuju. Marlia masih menganggap Hans orang asing yang hanya mahu mengambil kesempatan ke atas kekayaan keluarga mereka. Marlia mahu Ira cepat sembuh dan meminta cerai dari Hans. Ira pula semakin bosan dan tertekan dengan desakan Marlia. Sedikit demi sedikit Ira mula dapat menerima kehadiran Hans. Hans mengajak Ira ke pantai untuk berehat dan menjalani terapi kaki. Ira setuju tetapi tidak mahu memberitahu Marlia. Apabila Marlia dapat tahu dia begitu marah dan bimbang jika Ira jatuh cinta dengan Hans.

programme.desc: Abdullah meninggalkan keluarga bagi mencari rezeki di kota. Di Kota beliau dikenali sebagai Shawn, memperolehi kekayaan selepas melibatkan diri dengan gangterisma dan kelab malam. Di kampung, Aisyah isterinya yang ditinggalkan telah melahirkan seorang anak perempuan bernama Murni. 20 tahun kemudian akibat tekanan keluarga dan kemiskinan, Murni lari ke ibukota. Murni kemudiannya jatuh cinta dengan Shawn dan berkahwin. Perkahwinan mereka mendapat seorang zuriat lelaki bernama Adam. Shawn mulai berubah dan bertaubat. Setelah beberapa lama, Murni dan Shawn bercadang untuk kembali berjumpa dengan ibunya dan membawa anak mereka bersama. Sesampai di kampung, Shawn Abdullah menyedari gadis yang dikahwininya adalah anak kandungnya sendiri. Dia memohon ampun kepada isterinya Aisyah dan ibunya atas ketelanjurannya. Shawn kemudiannya berjumpa dengan seorang ustaz meminta nasihat, dia akhirnya meninggalkan keluarganya dan menghilangkan diri.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Oleh kerna disebabkan ketaksuban cintanya itu membuatkan Fahmi sanggup mencari seorang bomoh untuk menghidupkan semula Riana. Riana telah berjaya dihidupkan semula dan mereka bersatu sehinggalah Riana melahirkan seorang anak. Namun benarkah itu adalah Riana? Apakah yang akan terjadi kepada kehidupan Fahmi selepas itu?

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: 3 Cewek Petualang
programme.desc: Sally, Lyla, Citra, Jubed dan Randu lima sahabat dari zaman sekolah menengah merancang satu pertemuan semula. Sally mengajak rakan-rakannya melawat sebuah pulau berhampiran Belitong.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP1
programme.desc: Aafiyah dan Rizq anak kepada pasangan Adelia dan Rafeeq. Aafiyah dimasukkan ke hospital, semasa abangnya menzirahi Aafiyah doktor mengesahkan gadis tersebut mengalami trauma dan lupa ingatan. Sebulan sebelum kejadian, Aafiyah menyambut harijadinya di sebuah hotel tempat ibunya bekerja. Disebabkan kesibukan bekerja, kedua-duanya meninggalkan Aafiyah keseorangan. Aafiyah ternampak seorang bertopeng membunuh seorang wanita, dia yang ketakutan cuba melarikan diri tetapi berjaya ditangkap oleh pembunuh tersebut. Aafiyah berjanji tidak akan membuka rahsia tersebut kepada sesiapa. Aafiyah bersama ibunya berjaya menyelamatkan berkereta keluar dari hotel. Namun pembunuh tersebut berjaya menahan mereka dan membunuh ibunya

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP3
programme.desc: Memaparkan Rafeeq bertekad mahu menghapuskan Afifah, supaya dia bebas dari cengkaman Zacky. Zacky berkawan baik dengan Rizq, abang tiri kepada Afifah. Bapa Afifah minta tolong Zacky dan Rizq membantunya memulih Afifah yang kini lupa ingatan dan mengalami truama. Adelia masih marahkan Afifah yang menyebabkan abangnya Zacky mengalami tekanan selepas dia memutuskan hubungan dengan Zacky. Adelia kemudiannya ke rumah abangnya, malangnya dia telah dibunuh. Zacky kembali berbaik dengan Afifah setelah gadis tersebut meminta maaf. Tanpa mengetahui sebenar Zacky ialah pembunun misteri tersebut.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP4
programme.desc: Affiyah ditemui cedera parah dan dihantar ke hospital setelah dilanggar dan dipukul oleh Rafeeq. Kejadian yang berlaku disaksikan oleh Razi. Ritz yang baru pulang kerumah cemas menemui mayat bapanya dan mayat Aeera mati dibunuh.Rafeeq menyalahkan Luzman kerana tidak menjalankan tugas dengan betul sehingga menyebabkan Aeera jadi mangsa. Kemudian berlaku pergaduhan apabila Luzman menemui mayat bapanya dibunuh Rafiq.Sepasukan polis sempat menyelamatkan Rafeeq yang tercedera akibat pergaduhan. Luzman ditahan dan Rafiq yang tercedera dimasukkan kehospital. Rafeeq mengambil peluang untuk membunuh Affiyah yang kebetulan sedang terlantar dihospital yang sama. Affiyah tersedar namun ingatannya tidak baik

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Game of Deceit ((骗中传奇))
programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. They even make the banker, HUNG LAW LOK LAUs business bankrupted and HUNGs daughter, PO, CHEUNG YUK SHAN has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN HSUAN JESSICA HESTERs female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent The First Tooth. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agents reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

(据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: War Of Thorns ((玫瑰战争))
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

(随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box ((大话西游之月光宝盒))
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II ((流浪地球2))
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: The Medallion ((飞龙再生))
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival. (香港侦探Eddie在拯救一个神话般的儿童时,在国际搜寻人口贩运集团的过程中死亡。 被神圣的Cadellion所恢复,他获得了非凡的治疗力量。 然而,当他的无情的神经元也夺取了它的权力时,Eddie必须冲进一个险恶的城堡,为生存进行残酷的斗争。)

programme.title: A Writers Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: Love Never Ends ((かぐや様は告らせたい-ファーストキッスは終わらない-))
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Detrimental ((见怪))
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster. (你智廉是个盲人,他在一个外岛的工厂工作。当工厂有一天被飓风与外界隔绝时,一个怪物出现,把任何人看到它变成黑影。你看不到怪物,他能够帮助其他同事安全逃脱,并战斗杀死怪物。)

programme.title: Scare Out ((异类))
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence units urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1 ((倚天屠龙记之九阳神功))
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sects Zhang Chui Shans son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government. (吴智(Wu Dang Sects Zhang Chui Shanss)的儿子张武智(Zhang Wu Ji)在为龙沙布雷(Dragon Sabre)而战时被无意中迷住了。 当他无意中从《吉温经记》中学习了强大的武术技能时,吴智(Wu Ji)开始帮助六大教派对抗腐败政府。)

programme.title: Old Fox ((老狐狸))
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body ((死尸死时四十四))
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos. (这部黑暗喜剧开始于一个不识别的尸体出现在一个住宅公寓的门上.担心尸体将把他们的公寓变成鬼鬼的公寓,这将导致房地产价值急剧下降,)

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II ((白发魔女传2))
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lians restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend (我印度男朋友)
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella ((大话西游之大圣娶亲))
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Leio ((恐怖巨兽))
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: Scare Out ((异类))
programme.desc: A leak of core technology from an advanced fighter jet programme sparks a national security crisis. As an intelligence units urban manhunt for the spy falters, suspicion turns inward, falling on one of their own. Trust unravels as two top agents, once allies, are drawn into a silent, ruthless duel where one misstep could prove fatal.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo (莱利奥波波)
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures. (从前的DJ KK和Ah Luke电台曾经非常受欢迎,但他们的不良态度和以极端为中心的行为使他们被解雇了。 迫不及待地回访,他们为寻找老年女性主机的新电台试镜。 假扮自己是老太太,这对夫妇出乎意料地找到了工作,引发了一系列可笑的冒险。)

programme.title: The Italian Recipe ((遇见你之后))
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love. (著名的流行偶像彭派去罗马参加一个现实秀,遇到一个梦想成为意大利大厨的普通女孩曼格(Mang ) 。 彭曼除了在罗马共度一个神奇的夜晚之外,没有什么共同之处。 随着两人开始相爱,他们的生活开始发生变化。)

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller ((冰封侠：时空行者))
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love Punch ((私恋失调))
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Ip Man 3 ((叶问3))
programme.desc: When some gangsters led by a ruthless American property developer force a school to sell their land, Ip Man fights to protect it. Subsequently, Ip Man is challenged by another Wing Chun master Zhang Tian Zhi for the Grandmaster title. Ip Man accepts the challenge for the sake of his family and disciples, and wins the duel for the title. (当一些由无情的美国房地产开发者领导的黑帮组织迫使一所学校出售他们的土地时,叶问会为保护土地而斗争。 随后,叶问会受到另一位翼中大师张天志的反对。 叶问会为家族和门徒接受挑战,赢得冠军。)

programme.title: The Convict Killer ((插翅难飞))
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - Black Leopard. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of Black Leopard, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West ((西游记))
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing. (故事是从同名的经典中国小说中改编的.故事讲述了唐山宗僧侣前往西方寻找佛教的苏格拉.在路上,他遇到了子,猪和沙武.)

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate ((舞衣))
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love. (这部杰作讲述了香港社会对爱情的不同观点和女性对爱情的不同观点的三个相互联系的故事.)

programme.title: The Swift Knight ((快杰狮子丸))
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue

programme.title: The Snake Prince ((蛇王子))
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs... (蛇王子住在康西的蛇山上,他们和人类生活和平,一千年.然而,一切都改变了,当蛇王子爱上了三位美女之一,在附近村庄表演一个感觉般的雨舞,)

programme.title: All Men are Brothers ((新水浒传))
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Chehs epic The Water Margin, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country. (这是一部长的史诗"水边缘"的续集,讲述了108名流浪者在梁山的七名战士的爱国故事.)

programme.title: Young Lovers ((年轻的情人们))
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls. (范,一个吉他的富人,前往日本加入一支摇滚乐队,)

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel ((武林风云))
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wus son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiongs three daughters. Eventually, Gans daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their fathers death.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl ((冰天侠女))
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers ((鬼画符))
programme.desc: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from Fake Ghost Catchers Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhus sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2 ((蓝与黑续集))
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlords beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Tea House ((茶馆))
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Pursuit ((当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynastys Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge. (这部电影讲述了宋朝陆军总教官林宗的故事,他被一名腐败官员陷害,不得不开始充满危险的流亡。 在一位和尚的帮助下,林宗终于能够复仇。)

programme.title: Hex after Hex ((邪完再邪))
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng. (绝对是这样一个的鬼魂,却是这样一个的鬼魂! 邪教经典导演Kuei Chih-hung用这个惊人的恐怖浪漫戏剧,)

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung ((广东十虎与后五虎))
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman ((剑神不败))
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagles own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid ((唐人街小子))
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space ((奸人鬼))
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together. (一个父母分居的年轻男孩试图在生活中找到幸福。 有一天,他遇见和交朋友的是一个善良的仁爱心,他决定让父母团聚,让他真正幸福。)

programme.title: The Silver Fox ((银狐))
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome Silver Fox and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: Blue Skies ((碧云天))
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show. (云在11点时替换另一位歌手,成为一夜之间一场轰动.她的成功却以高昂的价格来,因为她对钢琴家的爱情受到了痛苦.)

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Dukes daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters. (杜克斯女儿被臭名昭著的金龙山强盗绑架.一个名叫贝的剑手被派去拯救她,在旅途中预计许多危险,获得了来自一群善良的朋友的帮助,他们也是功夫大师.)

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer ((猎人))
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else? (Tycoon Zhou是一个订婚的花花公子,但这并不阻止他尽可能多地对女士施展魅力。 他有一本关于他浪漫的幻想的日记,很快,他所亲密的女子就被一对一地杀害。 周成为警方的头号嫌疑犯,但凶手是另一个人吗?)

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts ((少林武王))
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Bangalore Naatkal
programme.desc: Three cousins, Arjun, Divya, and Kannan, move to Bangalore for different reasons. Their journey is filled with challenges that alter their lives irrevocably.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Magalir Mattum
programme.desc: Prabhavati, a filmmaker, with help from her friends takes her mother-in-law, Gomatha, on a surprise trip to reunite with her school friends.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Danny
programme.desc: Police inspector Kunthavai teams up with Danny, a clever police dog, to solve a murder mystery involving a dangerous gang of serial killers in this thrilling investigation.

programme.title: Happy Birthday
programme.desc: A fearless man, entrenched in violence, must transform his life for love when he meets a sweet young woman. Will he succeed in leaving his past behind?

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kishkindapuri
programme.desc: During a ghost tour, visitors enter a radio station and awaken a dormant spirit. Trapped inside, they must find a way out as supernatural forces threaten them.

programme.title: Yaman
programme.desc: After losing his father to a bunch of scheming politicians, a young man decides to wade into the corrupt and unscrupulous world of politics to avenge his death.

programme.title: Kanaa
programme.desc: Kousalya, a farmers daughter, dreams of becoming an international cricketer and winning the World Cup. With her fathers support, she faces numerous challenges in her pursuit.

programme.title: Veeran
programme.desc: A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control.

programme.title: Theerkatharisi
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger repeatedly calls the police control room, tipping them off about impending crimes and accidents.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Junior lawyer, Ravindra, agrees to help a business magnate clear her fathers name of murder, but his true colors are revealed as more bodies appear.

programme.desc: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. They will suffer loss, and gain friends, as they discover what it means to be part of the Woodland Troop. (在这片小片林地里,两只年轻的猴子面对着他们一生中最艰难的时刻。当他们在世界上找到自己的位置的时候,他们必须学会谁是盟友,谁是敌人。应当信赖谁,应当避开谁。他们将遭受损失,应当获得朋友,因为他们知道加入伍德兰部队意味着什么。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators. (赞比亚的野生动物是生活难以生存的地方. 在这里,许多动物必须团结起来,帮助保护领土,保护后代,寻找食物和战胜掠食者.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered... (在卢安加瓦谷每天都会看到一个尸体,每个尸体都包含了导致他们死亡的故事. 在萨法里,我们调查了被发现的三具尸体的死因.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there. (赞比亚拥有三个非常特殊和不同的非洲沙漠。 低、热、热的Luangwa河谷、高、干枯的Liuwa平原和凉爽、湿润的Kasanka国家公园。 每一个地方都为选择在那里生活的野生动物提供了独特的地方。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape. (非洲稀树草原的存活需要生活在群落中的物种的guele和团队合作。 跟随非洲野狗和矮龙鹅的一天生活,看看他们如何依靠紧身的家族克服挑战性的景观。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in natures great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa. (复杂的关系网决定了地球上的所有生命:所有物种都是相互联系的,任何物种都不能孤立地生存。 虽然有些关系是片面的,但有些关系是互利的。从松散的结合到紧密的合伙关系,一切都在自然界中占有一席之地。 物种之间的复杂互动甚至不局限于动物,一些最佳的例子发生在非洲茂盛的山林中。)

programme.title: Wildlife Icons ((野性标志))
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic. (尼罗河鳄和河马是非洲的两个两栖淡水图标,它们存在于整个非洲大陆的水道、河流和湖泊中,包括南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔惊人的荒野。 这两个物种在几千年中共存,以不同方式演变为水生生物。)

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants ((Tusker: 龙争虎斗 of Elephants))
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal. (让你与所有阶段的非洲大象,克雷格,帕斯卡尔和以扫一起深入了解鱼的复杂生活.)

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale ((The Great 大象 Tale))
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story (子:洞穴故事)
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests. (向一个独特的禽族家庭稳步前进的鼓棒前进。 了解世界239个木匠物种,从大到小,为什么大自然是最优秀的动物 探索它们的飞行、攀登和呼唤技巧, 并查看它们的秘密巢穴。)

programme.title: A Bees Diary ((蜜蜂日记))
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story. (蜂巢里,有成千上万的小动物致力于实现一个共同的目标:殖民地生存.)

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys (火山性奥德赛)
programme.desc: Visit Anak Krakatoa as it enters a violent phase. Known as The Child of Fire, this volcano is an ancestor of Krakatoa, a volcano known for the largest eruption in modern history. Will its descendant repeat the pattern? (访问进入暴力阶段的阿纳克克拉卡托亚。这座火山被称为《火之子》,是克拉卡托亚的祖先,这是一座现代史上最大的火山爆发所闻名的火山。其后代会重复这个模式吗?)

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon ((Wild Side of 从地球到月球))
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West (吉姆伯利:澳大利亚西部)
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives. (避免鱼的皮和羽毛的危险,看 koolamana 鱼争取伴侣,和鱼的幼儿一起吃饭.)

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks. (向最古老、最致命的耐力掠食动物的自然物种之一俯首称臣。 观察虎鲨利用海龟巢穴的混乱,在缺氧的环境中生存,用埃普莱特鲨鱼生存下去,用幽灵鲨鱼抵御深海的压抑压力。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites. (以各种鲨鱼围观海洋,看看为什么这些掠食性鱼类在海底占优势。 与珊瑚礁鲨鱼一起跟踪珊瑚迷宫,躺在等待与大白鲨进行完美打击的等待中,与大白鲨一起开始史诗般的迁徙。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures. (横跨波纹沙丘,在卡拉哈里南部风湿的草原上,一座雄伟的骆驼角,它在这里站了两个世纪。这棵树从来不孤单,知道它如何为许多生物提供食物、住所和狩猎场。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.desc: 女鬼刘阿翠钟情以前邻居马素，欲与其结合，央求父亲携同金银珠宝向马提亲，撮合一段人鬼姻缘，马素年青憨直，不愿与鬼为伍，坚决拒绝，实则彼暗恋已有男友之邻居红卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，决定伺机行动

programme.title: 广东十虎与后五虎
programme.desc: 广东十虎之一谭敏之侄谭聪，在赌馆当巡场；一夜，十虎的徒弟及后人等四人，在赌场相聚时，旗人佟七带着前清官之子小虎突袭，把谭聪杀死原因是十虎之黎仁昭谭敏等，昔日曾把父杀死，以助反清义士蔡民义脱险小虎遂与师叔们联手，杀死仍在世的十虎及其后人传人，为父报仇...

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超，连败九十九名剑手，终在最后一击败在剑神手上五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑，遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰，夺取稀世的老鹰宝剑老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分，矢誓报仇，不自量力挑战五新，结果被打落悬崖之下...

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子
programme.desc: 青年谭东独自从大陆来港投靠祖父，因与黑社会人物徐豪结怨而遭陷害，迫于无奈偷渡到三藩市东在唐人街饭店觅得工作，后来又因打抱不平而再牵涉入黑帮恩怨中东更重遇徐豪，二人展开连场恶战

programme.title: 奸人鬼
programme.desc: 男孩小吉的父母离异后，希望寻找快乐的人生一天，小吉喜遇好心鬼简人，并结成好友好心鬼决定要帮助小吉的父母复合，令小吉得到真正的快乐

programme.title: 玉面飞狐
programme.desc: 夏梧与司马秋同为镖局掌门义子司马秋利欲薰心，设计弑杀师父，更以暗镖毁去夏梧面容重伤的夏梧怀抱年幼长女逃走，怀孕妻子却于昏迷中遭司马秋奸污夏梧隐居深山，将仇恨寄托长女青青，苦心培育其成为武艺高强的玉面飞狐，命她下山劫镖寻仇

programme.title: 艳阳天
programme.desc: 钢琴师李燕南与乐队指挥女儿陈小芸相爱，常指点她歌唱技巧小芸在一次代替演出中一鸣惊人，得团主及花花公子杜邦杰力捧小芸赴星马演出，心却惦念燕南，一夜与杜邦杰于车内发生争执，怎料汽车失事...

programme.title: 豪侠传
programme.desc: 平西王因与金龙山强盗结仇，女儿被掳走他非常焦急，请剑侠岳震北帮忙，岳估计一人之力不够，幸得多位武功高强的好友相助一同去金龙山破盗寨各人步步小心，希望能成功救人

programme.title: 猎人
programme.desc: 花花公子周国雄有一本猎人日记专门去记录他四出猎艳的故事，周丢弃刘明华，又去追猎吕绮美，刘突然遭人杀死后来周又去追求女学生朱丽珍...但当晚，吕遭杀死，警方向周追查同时周想到和他亲近的女人，一个一个的被杀死，嫌凶渐指向他，好像有人在陷害自己周开始追查真相

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春
programme.desc: 清廷派人扫平少林寺，杀掉所有少林弟子从中幸存出来的两名弟子，分别拜入咏春及洪拳师傅门下，学习拳法最终他们挟技击败敌人，并为死去师兄弟报仇

programme.title: 兄弟帮

programme.title: 天龙八部 第41集

programme.title: 玫瑰战争 第10集

programme.title: 蝉 第4集
programme.desc: 生父是绑架犯，继父是刑警的刑辩律师（钟楚曦 饰），多年前遭人报复痛失妻儿的大法官（吴镇宇 饰），善用人心，游走灰色地带的邪魅律政精英（郑云龙 饰），三个孤独的陌生人在硬核案件的刑事辩护中互相博弈，却越发惺惺相惜，是对手也似亲人，螳螂捕蝉，黄雀在后，三人间，互为猎物，亦互为猎手，究竟谁才是黄雀，谁又是那只蛰伏十二年，只为自由鸣叫，收获一季响亮夏天的蝉？

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第14集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变......

programme.title: 单恋双城 第2集
programme.desc: 任职旅行社的罗式适陈茵媺为公司开拓新业务，特赴马来西亚与客户开会，谁料被当地滑头导游陆恭梓陈展鹏破坏一切计划，二人因而结怨，式适的男朋友程展博杨明突然现身向她求婚...

programme.title: 状王之王 第11集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰......案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第18集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第6集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第14集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第16集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第19集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 모여라 딩동댕
programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 어린 철학자
programme.desc: lt어린 철학자gt는 정답을 맞히는 아이가 아니라, 자신만의 생각을 가진 아이로 자라도록 돕는다. 질문하고, 사유하고, 자신의 기준을 세우고, 주장할 줄 아는 인간으로 성장하는 시간! AI 시대, 대체 불가능한 인간이 되는 가장 근본적인 힘 - 철학 하는 힘을 키운다.

programme.title: 극한직업

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 세상에서 가장 아름다운 여행
programme.desc: 장애나 희귀병으로 고통받는 아이들과, 가난 때문에 치료를 포기 해야만 하는 위기에 처한 가정을 찾아가, 전문의, 심리학자, 상담사, 건축설계사 등 국내 최고의 전문가 그룹이 장애를 앓고 있는 어린이와 그 가정의 회복을 목표로 전문적이고 구체적인 해결 방안을 제시해준다 치료와 재활을 적극적으로 도와주는 솔루션 프로그램.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 舊車改造突擊隊 第5季第2集 -傳家卡車
programme.desc: 本集的車主喬治, 擁有一輛1971年的雪佛蘭小卡車, 是已故的岳父賀卜留給他的愛車喬治的太太凱西為了紀念亡父, 並讓已陪伴家人36年的卡車能恢復往昔的美麗, 因此報名將車交由奇普和改造大隊進行為期七天的變身大改造奇普依喬治的喜好, 保留原有的橘色車身和原裝飾條, 搭配黑色的駕駛室車頂, 橘黑相間的內裝座椅設計, 全新儀表板和頂級的正點音響設備, 讓原本外表老舊的卡車變得美麗動人, 讓人驚艷艾德布魯克引擎廠提供了310匹馬力的全新組裝引擎, 經藍西尼塗裝廠漆成和車身相同的鮮橘色, 讓引擎室和車身一樣明艷動人焦急等待的喬治, 看到愛車變得煥然一新, 除了感謝太太, 還保證要永遠珍愛這輛傳家卡車, 創造更多美好的回憶

programme.title: 浩克慢遊
programme.desc: 天很藍，世界很大我揹上背包，迎著陽光，享受寧靜五月，稻田由翠青轉為墨綠眼前的這熟悉景致，許久以來，和我們的生活緊密相連農人穿梭田中，白黃色汗衫在大片的綠中，格外明顯上學的小學生急忙跑過旁邊的小徑，差點撞上沾滿泥土的老野狼再仔細觀看，雲的流動，讓陽光在田中染上不同層次的綠，稻浪不規則的轉換樹枝的擺動落葉的方向，讓我看見風心要夠靜，旅行的況味才得以擴展開來童年的旅行叫遠足，關注的是書包得裝滿平日難得吃到的零食，至於去哪裡倒不是那麼重要年輕時的旅行，拚的是疾走的氣勢，一路騎車到墾丁，早上吃完包子，還可以在沙灘上奔跑一整天現在的旅行，我會放慢腳步，聆聽不期而遇的滿滿人情台灣的美，絕對處處充滿驚喜
